correctness.rationale: The reduced exact two-dimensional ODE follows from the source model. Direct differentiation of \(\operatorname{artanh}(w)-\operatorname{Ei}(\alpha d)/2+\log d\) vanishes. \(H\) has unique minimum at \((\log2)/\alpha\) and diverges as d tends to zero, yielding all cases. At threshold \(H_\alpha''(d_c)/2=\alpha^2/(2\log2)\) and \(\dot z=-(\alpha/2)z^2(1+o(1))\), giving exact critical constants. The standalone verifier passed 222 finite tests; no finite test is used to prove the infinite-domain claim.
